run_RUN_WITH_FLAG: run gtest_help_test_ with a given command-line flag and return exit code and output
test_GTestHelpTest_TestHelpFlag: test that the help flag prints the correct help message and skips test execution
test_GTestHelpTest_TestNonHelpFlag: test that tests run normally and no help message is printed without a help flag
test_testPrintsHelpWithFullFlag: test that passing --help flag prints the Google Test help message correctly
test_testPrintsHelpWithIncorrectFlagStyl: test that incorrect flag variants like single dash or slash still trigger help output
